# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 111 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 111

Jesus said: "The heavens and the earth will be rolled up in your presence, and the one who lives from the Living One will not see death." Does not Jesus say: "Whoever finds himself — the world is not worthy of him?"

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Two parts: an eschatological saying + a question
- "Rolled up" — the heavens and earth rolled up like a scroll (cf. Isaiah 34:4; Revelation 6:14)
- "In your presence" — the cosmic dissolution happens before you, in your sight
- "Lives from the Living One" — *onkh ebol* + *petonkh*: drawing life from the one who is Living (Jesus, God)
- "Not see death" — echoes Saying 1 and John 8:51
- The final question is a rhetorical appeal to the reader: "Does not Jesus say...?" — an unusual meta-reference
- "Finds himself" — self-knowledge/self-discovery as the key to transcending the world
- "The world is not worthy of him" — the phrase from Sayings 56 and 80
